verdict.rationale: Sentry's API and MCP integration allow programmatic access to manage and export data across organizations/teams and let AI assistants perform searches, triage, and project management, which could support bulk-style automation, but no evidence explicitly documents bulk-issue operations (e.g., mass resolve/ignore/tag) or batch endpoints for many items at once. missing for 10: explicit bulk-action API/endpoint documentation, UI or MCP evidence of multi-item batch operations, and hands-on confirmation of bulk workflows.
